responsibility: Defines low-level access to the representation and arithmetic properties of LONGREAL, including compiler-provided constants about radix and exponent range, floating-point mode flags, and operations such as exponent/fraction extraction, predecessor/successor, ulp, scaling, truncation, rounding, synthesis, and exception-status querying. It is the ISO introspection interface for long floating-point representation details in gm2.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface file for LowLong: it declares LONGREAL representation constants, mode flags, and low-level operations, whereas LowLong.mod provides the concrete builtins-based implementation of those primitives.
